cafe-laptop.subject_label: Working on a laptop in a cafe
cafe-laptop.reveal_note: In the AI image the laptop screen is rows of look-alike text with no readable words, his dark sweater merges into the chair behind him, and the woman outside the window has a smeared face. The real photo is a close crop of a hand with a smartwatch on a marble laptop.

contractor-cabinet.subject_label: A contractor at a wiring cabinet
contractor-cabinet.reveal_note: In the AI image two gloved hands reach the panel but only one arm leads to them, the gloves bunch into mitten shapes, and the orange wires glow like noodles that end at no terminal. The real photo is a man in a hard hat seen from behind, in ordinary flat light.

fingerprint-scan.reveal_note: In the AI image the reader has no keypad or clock, its screen is blank grey, the scanner is a plain glowing ring with no sensor window, and there is a USB port on its chin. The real reader shows the time, a keypad and a green fingerprint window.

security-gates.reveal_note: In the AI image there is no readable sign, number or screen text anywhere, the left and right sides mirror each other, and the horizontal bars run straight through the posts. The real photo has numbered gates, no-smoking signs and an information board.

suspicious-email.reveal_note: In the AI image the papers beside the laptop hold only smeared rows that look like text, the laptop has no logo, and the hand at his temple has smooth, over-long fingers. The real photo has sticky notes on the wall and a phone, a pen and papers on the desk.

team-meeting-laptops.reveal_note: In the AI image the chart on the wall screen has bars with no axes or labels, every cup and glass is identical, and the faces share the same smooth, glossy look. The real photo is a messier meeting, with real code on a laptop and people looking in different directions.

two-colleagues-talking.reveal_note: In the AI image the navy-suit man's hands are a knot of fused fingers, the other man's thumb is oversized, and below the table edge their clothes dissolve into vertical stripes. The real photo is a candid whisper with a real watch and ordinary hands.

two-monitor-desk.reveal_note: In the AI image both screens fill with look-alike code lines that cannot be read, the monitor cables lead nowhere, and a black upright object by the lamp has no clear purpose. The real photo shows a recognisable web page and a picture of Earth from space on its screens.

usb-drive.reveal_note: In the AI image the metal plug has two square holes in its top and its gold contacts on the tip instead of inside the opening, the engraved logo is a made-up glyph, and the cap's opening is much larger than the plug. The real photo has USB-A and USB-C ends, a braided strap and a matching cap.
